headline: Last morning step: SPF 50
subhead: Apply generously and evenly on face and neck
footnote: Labelled SPF 50, PA++++; in-vivo ISO 24444:2019, independent lab; SPF obtained: 56.
image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a pure white seamless paper backdrop, soft daylight from the upper left, a faint grey contact-shadow area on the right. Square 1080x1080. Keep the right 45% of the frame as an empty space, evenly lit, for a pack photo placed later, and keep the left half as a calm empty area for copy. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
photography_needed: A real creator selfie or talking-head frame (named, consenting) with natural, unretouched skin. No before/after, no result claims, no scripted testimonial.
caption: Apply on cleansed face after serums and moisturisers, generously and evenly on face and neck, at least 15 minutes before sun exposure; AM, every day. Labelled SPF 50, PA++++; the lab basis is in the footnote.
layout_description: Plain native feel: casual headline and one supporting line on the left; AI-generated selfie-style card with the AI-GENERATED mark; the real pack beside it; no emoji.
adaptation_notes: Format #31 Creator selfie: kept the front-camera selfie framing and a single plain caption; no first-person testimonial invented for the AI person. Severe, labelled.
writer: stand-in (Claude agent) following prompts/pipeline_brief_writer.md; user rules 2026-10-05 (active + strength shown, basis in footnote, no exaggeration, nothing pending)
person_prompt: a casual, natural front-camera selfie of an Indian man in his late 20s with medium-brown skin on a sunny apartment balcony in the morning, plain cotton t-shirt, relaxed half-smile, phone held at arm's length, nothing on his face or in his hands; soft daylight from the upper left, a softly blurred railing and sky behind him. Natural, unretouched medium-brown skin with visible pores and ordinary variation in tone, true to life, nothing implying a skin result. No product, bottle, dropper, tube, jar or packaging anywhere in frame; no text, no letters, no logos, no brand names.

verdict.label: Ready for human review
verdict.detail: No blocking or must-fix issues found. This is a pre-screen, not an approval: brand and legal sign-off is still required.

findings.message: SPF 56 is the lab-measured value; fine in the footnote as the test result.
findings.fix: Claim the labelled SPF 50; keep 'SPF 56 obtained (ISO 24444:2019)' as the test result in the footnote.
